event_summary: A brown round object and an orange rectangular object move downward from overhead holders and come to rest on separate white cushions.
raw_event_description: The video begins with two white cushions below a white background, with a brown round object held near a blue overhead holder on the left and an orange rectangular object held near an orange-and-black overhead holder on the right. After a long still interval, both objects leave the overhead area and move downward with visible blur. The brown object reaches the left cushion and remains there, while the orange object reaches the right cushion, changes from a more upright orientation to a flatter orientation, and remains there.

reasons: The two cushions, overhead holders, brown object, and orange object are visible before the main motion begins.
The scene is static at the start.
